signOutWithQueued.other: %{count} things you did have not reached dispatch yet. They stay on this phone and can only be sent by you — sign back in on this device to finish sending them.

profile.name: Name

permissions.title: A few permissions before you start
permissions.intro: Your phone will ask about each of these once. Here is what each one is for.
permissions.locationBody: Dispatch sees where you are so they can assign work near you, and your stops update as you drive. Background access is what keeps that working when the app is not open.
permissions.locationPartial: You allowed location only while the app is open. Tracking will stop when you switch away — you can change this in Settings.
permissions.notificationsBody: New work, dispatch messages and changes to your route. Without these you would have to keep checking the app.
permissions.cameraBody: Photos as proof of delivery, and scanning package barcodes. Only used when you are completing a stop.
permissions.blocked: You have declined this before, so it can only be changed in Settings.
permissions.outstanding: You can start without these, but some things will not work until you allow them.

connect.title: Connect to your Fleetbase
connect.intro: Enter the address your company gave you. You will sign in with your own account on the next screen.
connect.hostHint: For example fleetbase.yourcompany.com. https is assumed.
connect.noKeyNeeded: No API key is needed. The app checks the address itself, then you sign in with your own credentials.
connect.invalidUrl: That does not look like a web address. Check for a typo.
connect.insecure: That address is not secure (https). Your password would be sent in the clear, so it is not allowed.
connect.unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check the spelling, and that you are on a network that can reach it.
connect.notFleetbase: Something answered, but it is not a Fleetbase server.
connect.signInNext: Next you will sign in with your own email and password.

sync.title: Sync queue
sync.discardBody: “%{label}” will be deleted from this phone and never reaches dispatch. This cannot be undone.
sync.emptyBody: Work you do without signal waits here until it reaches dispatch.
sync.offlineNotice: Offline — this will send itself when you have signal again.
sync.explainer: Anything here is saved on this phone. It sends automatically when you have signal.

offline.title: Not loaded yet
offline.body: This needs a connection. It will load as soon as you have signal — nothing you have done is lost.

unreachable.title: Could not reach the server
unreachable.body: Your phone has signal but the server did not answer. It may be busy or briefly down.

sessionExpired.title: You have been signed out
sessionExpired.body: Your session expired. Sign in again to carry on — nothing you have done is lost.

notPermitted.title: You do not have access to this
notPermitted.body: Your account is not allowed to see this. Retrying will not change it.

notFound.title: This is no longer here
notFound.body: It may have been reassigned or removed since you last looked.

rejected.title: The server would not accept that
rejected.body: Something in the request was not valid. Check what you entered and try again.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.body: The server asked the app to slow down. Wait a moment, then try again.

server.title: Something went wrong on the server
server.body: This is not your phone or your connection. Try again shortly.

outdated.title: This version of the app is too old
outdated.body: The server no longer supports it. Update the app to carry on.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.body: That did not work, and the app is not sure why.
